final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy with 31 authoritative zones and 30 delegations. pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver, using pc1 as its root server; all 40 PCs point to pc32. The requested A and MX records are in place.

The baseline had no web service, so I assigned `www.example.com` to pc33 (`10.15.9.11`) and added a simple web server there. Existing interfaces, addresses, routes, and collision domains were preserved.

Static checks verified the zone and delegation mappings, glue records, client resolver settings, and PC startup script syntax. I could not run the lab or BIND’s configuration checks because Kathara, BIND, and a Docker daemon were unavailable in this environment. The lab images must provide `named` and Python 3 for the configured services to start.
